negative_findings.description: Every www.nbrm.mk URL tested returned HTTP 403 — both via WebFetch (banki-en.nspx) and via curl with a realistic desktop Chrome User-Agent (platezni-institucii-...nspx, registar-na-institucii-za-elektronski-pari.nspx, ghodishni_izvieshtai.nspx). The domain is clearly live and freshly indexed by search engines, so this is a WAF/bot-protection hypothesis, NOT a dead site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Domain-wide 403 to non-browser HTTP clients; all nbrm.mk candidates in this slice are therefore URL-and-confidence only, unverified by direct fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any production collector for this cell must use a real browser engine (headless Chrome / claude-in-chrome) or negotiated access; a naive requests/curl pipeline will silently collect nothing and may misclassify the entire central bank as dead.

negative_findings.description: portal.nbrm.gov.mk (surfaced in mk search results as a National Bank portal) returned curl exit condition 000 — no HTTP response, connection failed or timed out.
negative_findings.result_summary: No response; could be geo/IP filtering, TLS negotiation failure from this host, or a portal that has moved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If this portal is the interactive statistics/time-series front end, it is potentially the single richest structured feed in the cell. It must be re-tested from a browser and a different network before any conclusion is drawn.

negative_findings.description: I could not locate a distinct standalone page slug for the 'Регистар на платежни институции' (Register of Payment Institutions) itself, despite finding sibling registers (e-money institutions, payment system operators) and the parent hub. Two targeted mk queries and one bilingual query failed to surface it.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register is legally mandated (per the licensing/registers decision, Off. Gazette 289/22) and almost certainly exists as a page or PDF under the registers hub, but its URL was not observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payment institutions are the fastest-moving regulated actor class in MK; missing this register leaves a hole in the actor map. Must be resolved by browsing the registers hub in a real browser.

negative_findings.description: No machine-readable open-data endpoint (CKAN, API, JSON, data.gov.mk dataset) for NBRSM banking or payments data was found in either language. Local terms 'отворени податоци' returned nothing NBRSM-specific.
negative_findings.result_summary: Distribution appears to be HTML pages plus XLS/PDF attachments only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection cost and fragility are higher than for peer central banks; budget for document parsing rather than API ingestion.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: If EN lags MK, an English-only collector would systematically miss the newest disclosures — reinforcing that MK must be the primary collection language.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to fetch a full issuer index at https://www.mse.mk/mk/issuers/all and https://www.mse.mk/mk/issuers/companies; both returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: No issuer index URL confirmed. Individual issuer pages exist under /mk/issuer/{slug} (confirmed for komercijalna-banka-ad-skopje, nlb-banka-ad-skopje, unibanka-ad-skopje) and MSE site search at /mk/search/{term} resolves slugs reliably.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without the index, bank-by-bank slug resolution must go through site search rather than a single crawl entry point; slugs must not be guessed.

negative_findings.description: seinet.com.mk returned effectively empty bodies (only the title 'SEI Net') on both the root and an individual document URL via plain HTTP fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Content is present per search-engine indexing and per the MSE RSS feed which links these exact document IDs, so the site is live; the failure is a rendering/tooling limitation, NOT a dead source. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for the single most important source in this cell must assume headless-browser rendering or discovery of the underlying JSON API.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a KHV page dedicated to approved prospectuses / emission decisions for banks specifically.
negative_findings.result_summary: No bank-segmented prospectus register was located on sec.gov.mk. Bank emission approvals appear embedded inside the general Месечни извештаи and session announcements rather than in a filterable register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank capital-raise detection requires parsing narrative monthly reports rather than reading a structured feed — a real extraction cost to budget for.

negative_findings.description: Run languages were scoped to mk and en; no Albanian-language (sq) queries were run despite Albanian being an official language in North Macedonia and sec.gov.mk offering an AL version.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian-language disclosure surfaces are uncovered in this slice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Some regulator and issuer communications, and Albanian-language financial press covering Halkbank/TTK, may be missed.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated banking or payments association page was found under the Economic Chamber's finance landing page (mchamber.mk/mk/home/finansii). That page turned out to be a list of donor/IFI financing programmes (GGF, EFSE, EBRD GEFF/ENEF, EIF WB EDIF, KfW, WBIF) rather than a sector association hub.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched the page; it contained only external finance-programme links, no member lists, analyses or association publications.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents mis-routing the crawler to a dead-end landing page; the correct chamber entry point for this cell is the Здружение на финансиски организации page (zdruzenijainfo/14), not /home/finansii. The IFI links are themselves a separate (out-of-cell) lead.

negative_findings.description: The guessed MASIT members index URL https://masit.org.mk/en/members-en/ returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: 404 Not Found. Individual member profiles under /en/members-en/<slug>/ do exist, and a paginated category index exists at /en/category/members-en/page/N/ (13+ pages observed via search).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The correct crawl entry point is the paginated category archive, not the bare /members-en/ path. Recording this avoids a wasted crawl branch. This is a moved/absent index, not evidence the directory is gone.

negative_findings.description: afd.mk (Alternative Financial Services Association of North Macedonia) failed to resolve via WebFetch (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) despite appearing in search results with current-looking English and Macedonian content snippets from /en/ and /en/za-nas/.
negative_findings.result_summary: DNS resolution failure on a single attempt; site content is indexed and appears live.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis (resolver, geo-block or transient DNS), NOT a verdict that the site is dead. AFD is the only fintech/non-bank association found for MK and would be a significant coverage loss if wrongly dropped. Must be retried by the verification pass.

negative_findings.description: No publicly downloadable MBA sector report, banking-statistics yearbook or standalone position-paper PDF was located during this pass. Publication evidence was limited to references (MiCreS newsletter volumes, a financial-inclusion brochure and guidelines for banks) surfaced in search snippets rather than direct file URLs.
negative_findings.result_summary: MBA appears to publish mostly as web pages and event material rather than as a numbered PDF report series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets expectations for the collector: MBA should be treated as an HTML-diff source with occasional attachments, not as a PDF-report publisher like a central bank. Deep crawl of /w/mk/nastani/ is needed to find the actual attachment URLs.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) search was executed for association/chamber terms, despite Albanian being a co-official language and OEMVP publishing primarily in Albanian.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian terms such as 'Oda Ekonomike', 'shoqata e bankave', 'anëtarët' were identified but not used as query terms in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Association material aimed at the Albanian-speaking business community (including member lists and event materials) may be entirely missed by mk/en-only querying.

negative_findings.description: The acronym 'СКМ' and the abbreviation 'skm.mk' are ambiguous in Macedonian search: skm.mk resolves to Стоматолошка комора (Dental Chamber), while СКМ is used for Стопанска комора на Македонија. Similarly 'МБА' collides with MBA (the business degree) in mixed mk/en corpora.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both ambiguities produced off-target results during searching.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query construction for this cell must pin acronyms with a disambiguating co-term (e.g. 'МБА' + 'банкарска' or 'банки'; 'СКМ' + 'стопанска') or use full names, otherwise recall/precision degrade badly.

negative_findings.description: Both mchamber.mk and fic.mk run legacy ASP.NET sites with query-string navigation (Default.aspx?mId=&htmlId=&lng=) and, on mchamber, embedded cookie/session tokens in paths (e.g. /(S(2wn2wc45pcvdrzi1cx3slzax))/default.aspx). Two parallel hostnames also coexist: mchamber.mk and mchamber.org.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Menu links are not stable, statically resolvable URLs; the same content is reachable under multiple host and path forms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive crawler will duplicate content, generate infinite session-id URL variants and fail to build stable document identities. URL normalisation (strip S(...) segments, canonicalise host, key on mId/htmlId/id parameters) is required before scheduling collection.

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of https://finance.gov.mk/mk-MK/oblasti/finansiski-sistem returned ECONNREFUSED (95.180.140.116:443).
negative_findings.result_summary: No content retrieved from the MoF financial-system section on the first attempt. Search-engine results show the domain serving pages normally, so this is treated as a hypothesis of geo-blocking or bot filtering, not a dead site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The MoF portal is the highest-priority source in this cell; a collector must be configured with realistic headers and possibly a regional egress, and must not mark the site dead on a single failure.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian for a standalone national payments strategy document owned by the Ministry of Finance.
negative_findings.result_summary: No distinct MoF-authored 'национална стратегија за платежни системи' surfaced. Payments strategy in MK appears to be carried by the National Bank (payment-systems strategy/oversight) and by the ЗПУПС law plus EU-approximation programmes, rather than by a separate MoF strategy paper.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not assume an MoF payments strategy exists; the equivalent policy signal must be reconstructed from ЗПУПС implementing acts, the Reform Agenda, and NBRM documents (covered by the central-bank cell).

negative_findings.description: Looked for financial-sector-specific statistics published by the State Statistical Office (as opposed to the National Bank).
negative_findings.result_summary: ДЗС publishes by subject area and via MakStat, but the searches did not surface a dedicated 'financial institutions' statistical release series; monetary and banking aggregates are produced by NBRM (nbstat.nbrm.mk).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids duplicated effort: for banking aggregates the collector should target the central-bank cell's nbstat PX-Web, and use ДЗС for ICT-usage, business demography and macro context instead.

negative_findings.description: Official Gazette (Службен весник) full-text search and consolidated legal texts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Individual issue PDFs are openly reachable at /Issues/{guid}.pdf, but it is unclear from search results whether structured full-text search, the consolidated texts service and the mobile app require a paid subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Legal-monitoring cost and method depend on this; a subscription may be needed for reliable amendment tracking rather than PDF scraping.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language search was performed for this cell despite Albanian being an official language in North Macedonia and the State Audit Office branding itself bilingually (Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit).
negative_findings.result_summary: Run scope specified languages mk and en only; Albanian-language state publications were therefore not searched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Some state bodies publish Albanian versions; ignoring them may miss documents or mislabel coverage as complete.

negative_findings.description: Kapital (Капитал), the Skopje business weekly, appeared only as an English Wikipedia entry in results; no current live kapital.mk-style URL was returned by the queries run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Outlet exists as a title but its current web home was not established in this pass; recorded as unverified rather than invented.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Kapital is historically the leading MK business weekly and would likely be a top-tier cell source; leaving it unresolved is a real gap.

negative_findings.description: No MK-language media coverage specifically about POS-terminal vendors, ATM fleet procurement, or card-personalisation contracts surfaced under the payments queries used.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments coverage found was consumer-side (fees, outages, wallets), not supply-side/vendor.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-side signals are commercially the most actionable; their absence in media means they must be sought in tenders/registries, not press.

negative_findings.description: This cell is scoped to mk and en only; Albanian-language MK outlets (a substantial share of the domestic media market) were therefore not searched.
negative_findings.result_summary: No sq-language sources collected by design.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank branch/complaint/appointment stories aimed at the Albanian-speaking market may be missed entirely.

negative_findings.description: No fetch/liveness testing was performed on any URL in this slice; paywall, robots and bot-defence status for Bloomberg Adria MK, SeeNews and Makfax are inferences, not observations.
negative_findings.result_summary: All access_status values are hypotheses pending the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design (RSS vs crawl vs licence purchase) depends on real access status.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed endpoint was confirmed for any of the MK outlets listed; feed URLs were not returned by search and were not guessed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Feed availability unknown for all candidates.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Feeds would make monitoring far cheaper and lower-risk than HTML crawling.

negative_findings.description: No Fitch or S&P rating action on an individual North Macedonian commercial bank (e.g. Komercijalna Banka, Stopanska Banka, Halkbank Skopje) was located in open search — only sovereign actions plus banking-system commentary inside sovereign reports.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned Wikipedia/aggregator pages and sovereign rating items; no bank-level rating action surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-level external credit opinions may simply not exist for most MK banks (they are unrated), which means parent-group disclosures and NBRNM data are the only issuer-level substitutes.

negative_findings.description: Both major rating agencies' primary pages are registration- or subscription-gated; no fetch was attempted, so their live status is unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Rating detail is reachable in practice only via MoF mirrors, licensed wires, or a registered account.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline relying on direct agency scraping will break or violate terms; plan for mirrors plus a licensed feed.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language searching found no Macedonian-language edition of the regional/international aggregators in this cell (SeeNews, bne IntelliNews, Balkan Insight, European Western Balkans). MK-language results were dominated by domestic outlets (Meta.mk, MKD.mk, Makfax) and state sites, which belong to cell 13.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk query 'кредитен рејтинг Северна Македонија Фич...' returned only domestic MK media and government pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell-13/cell-14 split is real: the international-aggregator channel is effectively English-only, so MK-language monitoring must be handled by the domestic cell.

negative_findings.description: The Vienna Initiative website (vienna-initiative.com) was inferred from EIB/BIS references and not fetched; its current URL and document library are unconfirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Referenced indirectly via EIB press item and BIS speech about the Skopje Full Forum.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Should be verified in the deterministic liveness pass before being scheduled for collection.

negative_findings.description: No Moody's coverage of North Macedonia (sovereign or banks) was found in this pass; only Fitch and S&P appeared.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results consistently paired Fitch (BB+) and S&P (BB-/B) only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If confirmed, the external-opinion set for MK is two agencies, limiting triangulation; a targeted Moody's/Scope check is warranted.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated North Macedonia payments/cards conference with a published sponsor list was found. Payments content surfaces inside general ICT, e-commerce, capital-market or regional-summit events, or in the one-off EACHA annual conference hosted in Skopje.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched mk and en for a standalone MK payments conference; only EACHA (visiting European event), MASIT ICT forums, Macedonia2025 Summit, MSE annual conference and an e-commerce conference were identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sponsor-list intelligence for this market must be assembled from adjacent events rather than from a single payments show; collection design should cover several event families.

negative_findings.description: No public, itemised consumer-complaint register or statistics dashboard for banks/PSPs was located at the central bank or elsewhere in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBRSM pages surfaced consumer-credit protection material and banking-system indicators, but no complaints docket comparable to an ombudsman register; OPM offers intake forms, not published case data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Complaint-volume trend analysis by institution may be impossible from open sources; the fallback is qualitative theme extraction from OPM handbooks, media and any NBRSM annual-report sections.

negative_findings.description: No domestic North Macedonian banking/fintech award programme was identified; the recognitions circulating in MK press are all foreign (The Banker, Global Finance, EMEA Finance).
negative_findings.result_summary: mk query for 'банка на годината' returned only foreign-award coverage republished by MK outlets.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Award signals for MK must be tracked at the international award bodies and mirrored through MK press; there is no local jury whose criteria could be mined.

negative_findings.description: Payten and Halcom were probed as regional payment-vendor actors with possible MK presence, but no MK-specific site, office or careers page for either was confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query returned CaSys as the confirmed MK processor; no MK-localised Payten/Halcom page surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The MK vendor actor map is currently thin beyond CaSys and KIBS; a dedicated vendor-mapping pass (company registry, tender records, MASIT members) is needed.

negative_findings.description: No stable Macedonian-language term for vendor-named core-banking or card-management platforms was established; job ads use generic phrasing ('Сектор за ИТ', 'апликативни решенија') rather than product names in the snippets seen.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk hiring queries yielded department names and generic role titles; product names appeared only in English where present at all.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Platform-identification from MK job ads will require full-text retrieval of ad bodies plus an English product-name dictionary, not mk keyword search alone.

negative_findings.description: Searches did not surface any national web-archiving programme for the .mk domain (e.g. a National and University Library 'Св. Климент Охридски' web archive or an MK legal-deposit web harvest).
negative_findings.result_summary: No MK national web archive identified; Internet Archive appears to be the de facto archival layer for MK bank and regulator sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a national harvest, historical MK bank disclosures survive only through Internet Archive coverage, which is thin for JS-heavy IR pages and PDF-behind-form assets — argues for our own proactive save-page-now programme.

negative_findings.description: The open-data portal was confirmed to exist (data.gov.mk / otvorenipodatoci.gov.mk) but searches returned no evidence of dedicated banking- or payments-sector datasets published there.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portal exists; banking/payments dataset coverage unconfirmed and likely sparse.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the portal carries no financial-sector datasets, the reconstruction of time series must fall back on NBRM statistics and MAKStat rather than machine-readable open data.

negative_findings.description: No DSpace/EPrints-style open institutional repository for UKIM or other MK universities was identified; theses appear to be served as loose PDFs from faculty WordPress uploads instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: No harvestable OAI-PMH endpoint found for MK academic banking literature.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Academic material must be discovered by ad-hoc site crawling and search rather than metadata harvesting, raising collection cost and lowering recall.

negative_findings.description: NBRM's /WBStorage/Files/ and bank /content/pdf/ stores are reachable by deep link but no evidence was found that directory listings are enabled, so contents cannot be enumerated directly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deep-link retrieval works; enumeration must come from Wayback CDX or site: queries.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines the collection method — CDX-driven URL discovery is mandatory rather than optional for these repositories.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all entries are search-derived and awaiting the deterministic verification pass. Paywall/anti-bot flags are hypotheses based on each platform's known model, not observed responses.
negative_findings.result_summary: All candidates unverified by design.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream stages must not treat any status here as confirmed.

negative_findings.description: For Халкбанк АД Скопје I could not locate a distinct 'Односи со инвеститори' / 'За акционерите' hub; reporting appears consolidated under a generic 'Годишни извештаи / Извештаи' page (halkbank.mk/godishni-izveshtai.nspx), and dividend/financial-data notices reach the market through the MSE free-market announcement channel instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Reports exist and are downloadable, but no shareholder-relations landing page was observed. Not a dead source — a structural difference.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for Halkbank must be seeded from the reports page plus the MSE issuer page, not from an IR-section pattern that works for KB/STB/NLB.

negative_findings.description: Fetching https://www.halkbank.mk/godishni-izveshtai.nspx returned site-wide product navigation rather than the report list; the report table did not appear in extracted text.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hypothesis: JS-rendered or frame-based report listing. Page is live (PDF children resolve), so this is unverified rather than dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive HTML crawler will silently collect zero Halkbank documents; a rendering fetcher or direct /content/pdf/<year>/Reports/ enumeration is needed.

negative_findings.description: https://www.kb.com.mk/... returned HTTP 302 to https://www.kb.mk/... for Komercijalna banka's IR page.
negative_findings.result_summary: kb.com.mk is a legacy alias; kb.mk is the live host. Not a failure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any stored historical URL under kb.com.mk must be rewritten to kb.mk or the crawler will log false failures.

negative_findings.description: For Силк Роуд Банка АД Скопје I found only the NBRM registry entry; no bank-hosted 'за акционери' or годишен извештај page surfaced in mk-language search within this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Unverified gap, not a confirmed absence — its own domain was not reached during this slice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A licensed MK bank would be missing from the IR corpus; needs a targeted follow-up fetch of its own website from the NBRM registry link.

negative_findings.description: Across KB, STB, NLB, Halkbank, TTK, UNIBanka, CCB, Sparkasse and Capital Bank, every annual-report/audited-statement artefact located in this pass was Macedonian-language; the Halkbank page read reported mk-MK as the active and effectively sole content locale.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cell's rationale is empirically supported: MK-language is the primary, and often only, publication language for IR documents.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An English-only collection strategy would miss the majority of MK bank primary disclosure. Cyrillic percent-encoded URL paths must be preserved byte-for-byte.

negative_findings.description: This slice ran almost entirely in Macedonian; I did not systematically probe the English mirrors (/en/ trees) of the same bank sites to measure lag or completeness versus the mk originals.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-side coverage of this cell is unmeasured.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Quantifying mk-vs-en lag is what justifies the MK-first collection design; it remains an assertion rather than a measurement.

negative_findings.description: OTP Group was listed in the cell brief as a possible MK parent, but no OTP-owned bank in North Macedonia was found. OTP's SEE footprint covers Slovenia, Serbia, Croatia, Albania, Montenegro, Bulgaria — not MK.
negative_findings.result_summary: No MK subsidiary identified for OTP in any search; MK bank lists do not include an OTP entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted collection effort on OTP IR for MK segment data, and flags OTP instead as a potential future acquirer to monitor rather than an incumbent parent.

negative_findings.description: The brief suggested 'Silk Road/Şekerbank-type owners'. Silk Road Bank AD Skopje is owned by Silk Road Capital AG (Switzerland), not Şekerbank; the Şekerbank link is not supported by anything found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ownership traced to Silk Road Capital AG following the 2016 purchase of Alpha Bank Greece's stake in Alpha Bank Skopje (ex-Kreditna Banka).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Corrects the actor map before collection begins; a wrong parent would send the pipeline to an irrelevant Turkish IR site.

negative_findings.description: Silk Road Capital AG is a private Swiss investment group with no discoverable investor-relations or annual-reporting channel disclosing the MK bank as a segment.
negative_findings.result_summary: No parent-level IR site, annual report or segment disclosure found for Silk Road Capital AG.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For this bank the cell's premise (parent IR reveals MK numbers) fails; collection must fall back on MSE/NBRM filings and the subsidiary's own reports.

negative_findings.description: ProCredit Holding reports North Macedonia inside an aggregated South-Eastern Europe segment rather than as a standalone reportable segment; a separate entity named ProCredit Reporting DOOEL (MK) is explicitly described as immaterial and not broken out.
negative_findings.result_summary: Country detail appears mainly as narrative (e.g. green-loan portfolio growth) plus CBCR tables, not as full segment financials.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for extraction: expect narrative mentions and CBCR rows, not a full MK P&L, from the ProCredit group reports.

negative_findings.description: The Steiermärkische Sparkasse Geschäftsbericht PDF itself was not located in this run — only the group's Southeast Europe overview page was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: German-language search surfaced corporate/overview pages and third-party profiles but no direct annual-report PDF URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Steiermärkische is the parent of the merged Sparkasse+Ohridska entity (~13.4% MK market share), so this is the single largest open gap in the cell's document inventory.

negative_findings.description: The NBG Group investor-relations URL was inferred from NBG's known corporate structure and was not fetched or confirmed in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches confirmed NBG's majority ownership of Stopanska Banka but returned no direct NBG IR page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Stopanska Banka is the 2nd largest MK bank; its parent's IR path must be confirmed by the verification pass before any collector is pointed at it.

negative_findings.description: A possible sale of Stopanska Banka by NBG (to Steiermärkische or any other buyer) was probed and no evidence was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: No press release, filing or credible report of a divestment surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Treat any such claim as unverified; the ownership map should keep NBG as the current parent until a primary disclosure says otherwise.

negative_findings.description: No free, machine-readable bulk download or open API of the Macedonian Trade Register or Register of Annual Accounts was found. Searches in Macedonian for отворени податоци / API / CSV on crm.com.mk returned only the statistical bulletin and the publications listing, both HTML-oriented.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk access appears to exist only through the contracted, prepaid Дистрибутивен систем and through BIFIDEX; free access is per-entity and explicitly limited to personal, non-commercial use.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The MK statutory-filing layer cannot be scraped compliantly at scale. The collection design must budget for a licensed channel from the start rather than assuming an open register.

negative_findings.description: The exact public search endpoint of the Регистар на вистински сопственици (UBO register) was not located. All results were news/announcement pages about its launch and upgrades, plus a support contact (rvs@crm.org.mk, +389 2 3288 602). Whether the general public can search it freely, or only obliged entities and authorities can, was not established.
negative_findings.result_summary: UBO register confirmed to exist and be operational; access tier and query URL unresolved in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership data on MK payment-services companies is a core deliverable of this cell; not knowing the access tier blocks planning and could mean an FOI or contractual route is required.

negative_findings.description: Several crm.com.mk pages returned only a title or a maintenance notice to the fetcher: the /DS/ ASPX pages (Дистрибутивен систем), the /en homepage, and the Статистички билтен page (which served a Macedonian 'service temporarily unavailable due to parameter updates' notice).
negative_findings.result_summary: Content could not be read; hypothesis is server-side session/postback rendering or transient maintenance rather than dead URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are exactly the pages that document the paid bulk channel and the sector statistics. A verification pass with a real browser session is needed before any of them is judged unusable.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian for a ЦРРСМ-published ranking of largest companies (equivalent to a '200 најголеми' list) derived from filed annual accounts. No such registrar publication surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the Статистички билтен appeared as a registrar analytic product; company rankings, if they exist in MK, are likely produced by media/consultancies rather than the registrar.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes a hoped-for shortcut to ranked financial data on MK banks and payments firms; ranking-type intelligence will have to come from BIFIDEX screening or from media/consultancy sources in another cell.

negative_findings.description: No public interface was found that lets you list all MK entities by NKD activity code (e.g. 64.19 banking, 66.19 auxiliary financial services, 82.91) — the free ЦРРСМ search is name/ЕМБС-driven only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Building the full population of MK payments-sector legal entities from the registrar directly is not possible through free interfaces.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's rationale rests on the registrar revealing the full population; that requires either the Distributive System, BIFIDEX industry screening, a reseller dataset, or the NBRSM licensed lists as a proxy.

negative_findings.description: Register of Pledges (Регистар на залог) and Register of Disqualified Persons (Регистар на дисквалификувани лица) had usable Macedonian names but no clearly discoverable English-language landing pages or dedicated public search URLs in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed to exist via Macedonian sources and the DS catalogue; endpoints unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Both are useful risk-screening layers for fintech partner due diligence; they need a targeted follow-up on the Macedonian site tree.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public annual report or investor-relations page was located for KIBS AD or CaSys AD. Both are unlisted joint-stock companies; searches in mk ('годишен извештај КИБС', operator names + 'извештај') surfaced only registry aggregators, not an own-site report PDF.
negative_findings.result_summary: Operator-level financials appear reachable only via Central Registry filings / aggregators, not via operator IR pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means the A1 'annual reports / investor relations' topic cannot be served for the payments-infrastructure layer by direct disclosure; a registry-based collection route must be budgeted instead.

negative_findings.description: nbrm.mk returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain fetch of the payment-institutions/e-money/system-operators register page.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on one attempt; the same domain's pages are indexed and reachable in search, so this reads as bot defence rather than a dead page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The NBRM register is the canonical actor map for this cell; collection must use a headless browser with realistic headers, not a naive HTTP client.

negative_findings.description: kibs.mk news page fetched but returned only the page header and the section title 'ВЕСТИ И ПРОМОЦИИ' with no item list or links.
negative_findings.result_summary: Listing likely rendered client-side; item URLs not enumerable via plain fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: KIBS press releases are a primary signal for clearing-layer change; a JS-capable fetcher is required or the feed will silently collect nothing.

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found in this pass of an independent ATM-deployer / IAD operator active in North Macedonia (searched Payten/MoneyGet + mk terms 'банкомати', 'терминали'); MoneyGet hits were Serbia and Montenegro only.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK independent-ATM-network presence neither confirmed nor refuted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no IAD exists, the ATM estate is entirely bank-owned and switched by CaSys — a materially different market structure that should be established, not assumed.

negative_findings.description: Searching mk terms for a domestic mobile/instant payment consumer brand ('мобилно плаќање', 'паричник', 'платежна институција') returned only international wallet launches (Google Pay, Apple Pay) — no branded national instant-payment scheme name surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: The instant-payment initiative appears still to be referred to programmatically (TIPS clone / иницијатива за инстант плаќања) rather than under a consumer brand.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword monitoring must be built on programme terminology, not a brand name, until a brand is announced — otherwise the launch will be missed.

negative_findings.description: Several licensed or newly licensed MK e-money/payment institutions (Flex Pay, MINT Fintech Group, and, in this pass, Paysera's MK arm) could not be tied to a confirmed corporate press-room URL. Their announcements surfaced only through mk media reproductions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Actor confirmed to exist; owned publishing channel not located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for these actors must be media-mediated, which adds latency and paraphrase risk; the source list will look thinner than the market actually is.

negative_findings.description: mk queries combining remittance vocabulary ('дознаки', 'брз трансфер на пари') with 'соопштение'/'нова услуга' returned only static bank product pages for Western Union — no dated press releases from remittance operators or their MK agents.
negative_findings.result_summary: Remittance-corridor news appears not to be published as PR in MK; only tariff/product pages exist.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Remittances are economically large for MK, so the absence of a PR channel means corridor change must be inferred from tariff-page diffs and NBRM statistics instead.

negative_findings.description: No established Macedonian-language term was found in use for SoftPOS or BNPL; searches had to fall back to the English-in-local forms ('SoftPOS', 'BNPL', 'одложено плаќање' untested).
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language glossary gap for two of the cell's named product themes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without correct mk terms these product launches will be missed by mk-language monitoring; needs a glossary-building pass with native phrasing variants.

negative_findings.description: The NBRM registers of payment institutions and e-money institutions are described in regulation and referenced on nbrm.mk, but the exact register listing URL was not isolated in this pass — only the governing decision page was.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register exists and is public; direct URL unresolved, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This register is the backbone of the actor map for the whole cell; leaving it unresolved caps the completeness of any downstream actor list.

negative_findings.description: No Visa country newsroom or Macedonian-language Visa press page for North Macedonia was found. Searches in both en and mk returned only Visa global/regional newsrooms and MK bank product pages carrying Visa branding.
negative_findings.result_summary: Visa MK announcements, if any, appear to be routed through issuing banks and local media rather than a Visa-owned MK channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Scheme-side coverage for Visa in MK must be built bottom-up from issuer pages and MK media; a Visa-domain crawl alone will under-report.

negative_findings.description: Targeted searching for MK bank customers of the large global core-banking and self-service vendors (Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Diebold Nixdorf, NCR/NCR Atleos, Euronet, BPC, OpenWay) surfaced no MK-named press release or case study.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only generic product/comparison pages and third-party customer databases returned; no MK deployment named.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Core-banking platform ownership for MK banks remains unmapped; this is the single largest hole in the vendor picture and likely needs procurement notices, RFP archives, or job-ad/skills evidence instead of vendor marketing.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language searching for vendor references ('референци', 'решение', 'соопштение' + Македонија + банка) mostly returned legal texts, registry/company-profile aggregators and chamber listings rather than vendor case studies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Regional vendors publish in English; MK-language material about them is produced by media and directories, not by the vendors.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language crawling should be pointed at MK media and associations for vendor news, while vendor-owned collection stays English - splitting the pipeline by language accordingly.

negative_findings.description: Printec's MK country page was located but no MK-specific press release feed was identified in this pass; only a group-level blog and resources library.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK customer facts appear as prose on the country page rather than as dated releases.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Undated marketing prose cannot anchor a timeline; deployment dates for MK self-service estates will need corroboration from another source class.

negative_findings.description: Neither Macedonian- nor English-language search surfaced a specific, currently-open tender for платежни услуги / банкарски услуги from a MK public body. Search engines index the ESJN's ASP.NET notice pages very poorly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portal-level sources found and documented, but no individual banking/payment notice retrievable via general web search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell cannot be worked by web search alone — collection must go through the ESJN's own search UI (or OCDS bulk data), driven by CPV codes and buyer filters.

negative_findings.description: A TED query for North Macedonia banking-services notices returned only an unrelated MK goods notice (road-marking machine, 200814-2025). No MK financial-services notice was located through general search.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED confirmed as a valid channel for MK notices, but banking-specific MK notices were not surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MK is not an EU member, so its notices reach TED only above thresholds or via EU/IFI-funded procedures; TED should be treated as a supplement to, not a substitute for, the national portal.

negative_findings.description: The State Appeals Commission appears under at least three hosts — dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk, and dkzjn.sorsix.com — with documents served from more than one. Which is canonical was not established, and no fetch was attempted to confirm liveness.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three candidate hosts recorded; canonical host unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pinned to the wrong host will silently stop receiving decisions after a migration.

negative_findings.description: The data.gov.mk organisation URL for the Public Procurement Bureau appeared as a mojibake/transliterated slug (bnpo-3a-jabhn-ha6abkn), suggesting Cyrillic-to-Latin corruption somewhere in the portal or the index.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dataset list for BJN on the open-data portal not confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Open data may be a cheaper collection route than scraping; its actual existence and freshness need direct verification before planning around it.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language equivalents were used for the IFI/donor sources (EBRD, EIB, World Bank, WBIF, TED) because these bodies publish MK-related procurement in English only; MK-language mirrors of their notices were not found.
negative_findings.result_summary: IFI layer of this cell is English-only by nature.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring will structurally miss donor-funded financial-infrastructure procurement; the English channel is mandatory, not optional, for full coverage.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'набавки'/'тендери'/'добавувачи' or supplier-registration page was found on the websites of the systemic private MK banks (Комерцијална банка kb.com.mk, Стопанска банка stb.com.mk, НЛБ Банка nlb.mk, Халкбанк halkbank.mk, Шпаркасе Банка).
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted mk-language searches on each bank name plus набавка/тендер/оглас за понудувачи returned only employment ads (огласи за вработување), product notices and financial reports — no procurement notice board or vendor-onboarding form.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell hypothesis: private MK bank spend has no self-published tender channel, so the collection strategy must lean on IFI portals, gazette notices, trade press and financial disclosures instead of bank procurement pages.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific commercial aggregator was confirmed to actually carry private-sector (non-ESJN) bank RFPs.
negative_findings.result_summary: tenderi.mk, etenderi.mk, servisea.mk and the foreign aggregators all present themselves around јавни набавки/ESJN data; private coverage is claimed by macedoniatenders.com and j360.info but was not observable without a subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any budget spent on aggregator subscriptions should be gated on a coverage test, otherwise the run pays for re-listed public-portal data it already has.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetch of https://tenderi.mk/ returned empty content on one attempt.
negative_findings.result_summary: Single empty response; the domain appears in search results with live subpages (/tenders, /pricing).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Treat as bot-defence or JS-rendered, not as dead; requires a browser-based or manual check in the verification pass.

coverage_gaps.description: All 24 nbrm.mk candidates are recorded from search-engine evidence only; none could be opened directly because of the domain-wide 403.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run a liveness and content pass using a real browser engine (claude-in-chrome or headless Chrome with full header set) before this slice is promoted to a collection plan; treat current URLs as high-confidence but unverified.

coverage_gaps.description: I identified landing pages but not the underlying PDF/XLS document URLs (one exception observed: /content/Annual_Report_2020.pdf, implying a /content/ document root).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the /content/ path pattern from a browser to build a direct document index; this is likely the cheapest stable ingestion surface and may bypass some page-level defences.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is a POINTER cell but its registers were not opened, so the actual named entities (payment institutions, e-money institutions, payment system operators, savings houses, exchange offices) were not enumerated. Only the bank list was recoverable indirectly via secondary sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Once register pages are fetchable, extract entity names into an actor table and spawn per-actor IR/disclosure scouting cells (starting with KIBS AD Skopje, which is named but has no cell).

coverage_gaps.description: Bank disclosure in MK is also driven by the Official Gazette (Службен весник) and by the Securities and Exchange Commission / Macedonian Stock Exchange for listed banks — outside this cell's boundary but load-bearing for 'disclosures / investor relations / earnings' topics.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a separate cell for Службен весник (regulation change feed) and one for Македонска берза (listed-bank IR, quarterly and annual filings).

coverage_gaps.description: The payment-institutions register page slug remains unfound (see negative finding).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Browse https://www.nbrm.mk/registri-pups.nspx in a real browser and enumerate its child links.

coverage_gaps.description: MSE issuer-page slugs confirmed for only 3 of the listed banks (Komercijalna, NLB, UNI Banka). Stopanska (STB), Halkbank, Sparkasse, TTK, Centralna kooperativna and Razvojna banka slugs remain unresolved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run https://www.mse.mk/mk/search/{bank-name} for each remaining bank and record the exact /mk/issuer/ slug plus trading symbol before building the crawler.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed structured API for SEI-Net; RSS gives headlines and links but the document bodies require rendering.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect network traffic of seinet.com.mk in a headless browser to locate the backing JSON endpoint; if none, standardise on headless rendering of /mk/document/{id} with sequential-ID backfill.

coverage_gaps.description: KHV monthly-report ID pattern is only anchored on one confirmed point (izvestaj67 = May 2012). The current ID range and whether older/newer reports use the same scheme is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.sec.gov.mk/Mesecni-izvestai index and probe the ID range to map the full archive; also locate Квартални извештаи and КХВ ставови sections.

coverage_gaps.description: The National Bank of RNM (НБРСМ / nbrm.mk) was touched only incidentally via a CDHV reference; it is the prudential supervisor and publishes bank-level supervisory and financial data that complements exchange disclosures.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat NBRSM as an explicit follow-up cell or extend this one: map its bank supervision reports, Извештај за банкарскиот систем, and individual bank data publications.

coverage_gaps.description: No Albanian-language search performed (out of declared run scope mk/en).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If scope permits, add sq queries such as 'Komisioni i Letrave me Vlerë', 'Bursa Maqedonase', 'njoftim aksionar bankë' to catch AL-language regulator pages and press.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) association and chamber sources were not systematically searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass with sq terms: 'Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë', 'shoqata bankare', 'anëtarët', 'kumtesë', 'raport vjetor', targeting oemvp.org and Albanian-language business media.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment-specific industry bodies (card scheme national forums, an ATM/POS operators grouping, or a payment institutions association under the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems) were not identified. Only KIBS (as an MBA member institution) surfaced as a payments-infrastructure actor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search explicitly for 'платежни институции', 'издавачи на електронски пари', 'здружение на платежни институции', and check whether the 2022 payment-services law spawned any self-regulatory body; also profile KIBS AD Skopje (kibs.mk) directly as an infrastructure operator.

coverage_gaps.description: For most association sources the existence of publications is established but the concrete artefact URLs (White Book editions, MiCreS newsletter PDFs, chamber annual reports after 2010, DMWV member directories for other years) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted file-discovery pass using site: and filetype:pdf queries against mba.mk, fic.mk, mchamber.mk/Upload/Documents/, dmwv.mk and masit.org.mk, plus Wayback Machine CDX enumeration for historical editions.

coverage_gaps.description: MASIT's full current membership (13+ pages of paginated profiles) and AmCham's and FIC's member lists were sampled, not enumerated. The bank-technology supplier layer is therefore only partially mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Schedule a one-off exhaustive crawl of masit.org.mk/en/category/members-en/page/1..N, amcham.mk members, and the FIC Business Catalogue; classify each member by whether it serves banking/payments.

coverage_gaps.description: Association event materials (conference agendas, sponsor lists, presentation decks) — historically the richest indirect reveal of vendor-bank relationships — were identified as a category but no concrete deck or agenda repository was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl mba.mk/w/mk/nastani/ and masit.org.mk event pages for attached agendas and sponsor logos; also check MASIT's flagship annual conference site if it is hosted on a separate domain.

coverage_gaps.description: Business Confederation of Macedonia and the European Business Association (both named in a US government listing of principal MK business associations) were surfaced but not investigated; the Сојуз на стопански комори website could not be confirmed live.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and profile these three bodies directly, and use biznisregulativa.mk/Komoris/ as the authoritative index of recognised chambers to ensure none is missed.

coverage_gaps.description: For UJP, the exact stable index page listing all e-Faktura technical specifications and API documentation was not pinned down; only one deep PDF path and the general announcements area were confirmed via search.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.ujp.gov.mk/ and its e-Faktura landing page directly to enumerate the specification index, then register that URL as the watch target.

coverage_gaps.description: Other state/quasi-state financial bodies in the same actor family were not covered in this slice: Customs Administration (Царинска управа), Central Registry (Централен регистар), State Foreign Exchange Inspectorate / Financial Police (Финансиска полиција), Public Procurement Bureau (e-nabavki) and the Securities & Exchange / MAPAS supervisors.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell (or assign an adjacent cell) to Царинска управа, Централен регистар, Финансиска полиција and e-nabavki.gov.mk — the last is a strong tender-signal source for bank/state payment-system procurement.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language mirrors of the MK state sources were only spot-checked (finance.gov.mk en-GB, dzr.mk English branding); it is unknown how complete or how delayed the English versions are.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample 5-10 documents per institution across mk and en to measure translation completeness and lag; default the collector to the mk version as source of truth.

coverage_gaps.description: APIs were identified in principle (MakStat PX-Web JSON-stat, data.gov.mk catalogue, UJP e-Invoice integration API) but none were exercised.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical spike against the PX-Web API and the data.gov.mk catalogue endpoint to confirm formats, rate limits and table ids before committing to a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of each publication series (how far back annual reports, audit reports and FIU reports go online) was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: During first crawl, record earliest available year per series and flag institutions where the archive was truncated by a site redesign (MoF is a known case, with content split between finance.gov.mk and arhiva.finance.gov.mk).

coverage_gaps.description: Broadcast media (Telma, Sitel, Kanal 5, Alsat, MRT) economy segments were not directly enumerated; only glimpsed indirectly via the GRID.mk aggregator.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated MK query set on television economy shows (e.g. 'ТВ дневник економија банки Македонија') and map broadcaster sites and YouTube channels.

coverage_gaps.description: Consumer-complaint channels beyond journalism (bank ombudsman-style reporting, consumer-organisation statements, Facebook consumer groups) are unmapped in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search MK terms 'жалби на клиенти банка', 'потрошувачка организација банки' and map the recurring commentators quoted in fee stories.

coverage_gaps.description: Archive depth per outlet is unknown; only emagazin.mk was observed to keep a separate historic archive.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each outlet for date-based archive indexes and sitemap.xml to estimate how far back a backfill can reach.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language MK-domestic reporting is thin in this cell; only regional wires (SeeNews, Bloomberg Adria) and a claimed bilingual daily were identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Verify whether Nezavisen Vesnik and any MK outlet run genuine English editions with banking coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell is almost entirely indirect/pointer by design; the one direct source found (Provizii.mk fee database) suggests other structured MK-language data products may exist unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search MK for comparison/calculator sites on loans, deposits and cards to find further structured local-language datasets.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group IR channels beyond NLB and ProCredit were not covered: Steiermärkische Sparkasse (Sparkasse Bank Skopje), Halkbank T.A.O. (Halkbank AD Skopje), OTP/Alpha-related entities, and Stopanska Banka's owner NBG legacy structures.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted pass over each foreign parent's IR/disclosure site for MK segment reporting and press releases.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-side international trackers are thin: card schemes (Visa/Mastercard CEE press), acquirers/PSPs, and fintech-market trackers covering MK were only lightly sampled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated payments sweep (scheme press rooms, Finextra, PYMNTS, ECB/EPC registers, Global Findex MK datapoints).

coverage_gaps.description: Structured statistical aggregators (World Bank Global Findex, IMF Financial Access Survey, ECB/BIS payments statistics) were not enumerated as machine-readable series for MK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Catalogue the API/bulk-download endpoints for Findex, IMF FAS and BIS/CPMI Red Book style payments statistics for MKD.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy identified for paywalled wires (SeeNews, bne IntelliNews) whose historical items are the main English record of MK bank earnings before ~2015.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate licensing or a library/database route (Factiva/Nexis) for back-file access.

coverage_gaps.description: No local-language (mk) source belongs in this cell by construction, so the cell contributes nothing to MK-language coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on cell 13 for mk-language coverage; ensure the MoF mk credit-rating page listed here is cross-linked rather than duplicated.

coverage_gaps.description: Careers pages were confirmed only for Stopanska Banka; the remaining MK banks (Komercijalna, NLB, Sparkasse, Halkbank, ProCredit, Silk Road, UNIBanka, Centralna kooperativna, ALTA, TTK, Kapital, Development Bank) and PSPs need their own careers-URL discovery.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-bank careers-page discovery pass using the NBRSM licensed-institution list as the actor spine; record canonical careers URLs and RSS availability.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) hiring, complaint and event channels were not searched, although a large share of MK banking customers and some bank communications are in Albanian (CaSys itself supports sq).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an sq query set (shpallje pune bankë, ankesa konsumatore, konferencë pagesash) in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement / tender notices (e-nabavki) were not covered in this cell but are a strong indirect signal for system purchases by state-owned or public-sector-adjacent financial institutions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the national e-procurement portal to the scouting scope and test whether bank-related IT tenders appear there.

coverage_gaps.description: Job ads and event pages expire quickly and are frequently deleted; without archiving, the historical hiring signal is unrecoverable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every captured ad/agenda to local storage plus a web-archive submission at collection time.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn holds the densest platform-naming hiring signal but is ToS-restricted and auth-walled, so it cannot enter the automated pipeline.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a manual analyst routine for LinkedIn with a fixed monthly checklist of entities, and rely on open job boards for the automated layer.

coverage_gaps.description: Per-issuer archival file stores were mapped only for Stopanska banka Skopje, NLB and Alta; the remaining MK banks (Komercijalna banka, Sparkasse, ProCredit, Halkbank, TTK, Uni banka, Silk Road, Centralna kooperativna, Development Bank of North Macedonia/МБПР) and savings houses have not had their PDF paths enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-domain Wayback CDX + site: PDF enumeration across the full NBRM list of licensed banks and savings houses, in both mk and en site variants.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival layer was mapped for the Комисија за хартии од вредност (Securities and Exchange Commission) or the Фонд за осигурување на депозити (Deposit Insurance Fund), both of which publish historical annual reports and decisions relevant to bank disclosure.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated mk-language pass on sec.gov.mk and fodsk.org.mk (or current domains) for report archives, then snapshot them.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival source was mapped for MK payments infrastructure operators (KIBS, CaSys, MIPS/MIPS-participant reporting), whose historical volume reporting is the backbone of any payments time series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search kibs.mk / casys.com.mk plus NBRM payment-system oversight reports in mk, and Wayback-enumerate those domains.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) sources were out of the declared run languages (mk, en) and were not searched, although a substantial share of MK banking communication and academic work is published in Albanian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If the run scope can be widened, add sq queries (raporti vjetor, banka, pagesa) against MK bank and university domains.

coverage_gaps.description: No proactive archiving of currently-live MK IR pages has been established, so pages pruned between runs will be lost if Internet Archive has not independently captured them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a save-page-now step to every collection run for all MK bank IR/press URLs touched, creating our own archival guarantee.

coverage_gaps.description: Not every NBRSM-licensed bank was reached in this pass. Silk Road Banka's own site, and any remaining smaller/savings institutions (штедилници), were not opened.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scrape the NBRSM banks-and-savings-houses list to build a complete seed list of legal names + official domains, then run one IR-section discovery fetch per domain.

coverage_gaps.description: Document examples collected span scattered years (2012, 2016-2018, 2021-2025) rather than a verified continuous series per bank; no per-bank inventory of which years are actually posted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each bank build a year x document-type matrix (годишен извештај / ревидирани посебни / ревидирани консолидирани / квартален извештај и податоци) and fill holes from MSE and SEINET mirrors.

coverage_gaps.description: No measurement of English-version availability or publication lag on any MK bank IR page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample three banks (KB, STB, NLB), compare /en/ IR trees against mk originals for document count and posting date.

coverage_gaps.description: None of these bank IR sections was observed to offer RSS, an API, or a dated index; discovery of new filings depends on polling.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Implement content-hash diffing per IR page plus id-space diffing on the predictable patterns found (stb.com.mk /media/<n>/, unibank.mk assembly number, ccbank.mk Sobranie<YYYY>, halkbank /content/pdf/<year>/Reports/).

coverage_gaps.description: Capital notices (докапитализација, издавање акции, subordinated debt) and takeover/public-offer documents were only glimpsed indirectly (MSE 'Јавни понуди за преземање' repository paths, e.g. Sparkasse and TTK takeover folders); no bank-site capital-notice page was mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add 'докапитализација', 'емисија на акции', 'јавна понуда за преземање', 'субординиран депозит' to the query glossary and map where each bank posts capital notices.

coverage_gaps.description: Robots.txt, terms of use and rate-limit posture were not checked for any of these bank domains.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before automated collection, fetch robots.txt and ToS per domain and record collection_allowed per host rather than assuming it.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed URL for the Steiermärkische Sparkasse annual report (Geschäftsbericht) or for any Sparkasse-group segment disclosure covering North Macedonia.
